highlights.title: "Needs you" means a bot is waiting on you
highlights.text: The sidebar says "Needs you" only for a question, an approval or a failed run. Finished work, like a routine run, shows as "New" in grey.

highlights.title: A routine run counts once
highlights.text: A finished routine run and its review item now count as one, so the sidebar, the Inbox page and the phone tab bar show the same number.

fixes: Drafting a goal no longer stops on a hidden "Allow once" card: the draft shows on the Mission board.
On a phone, the idle browser pane now says to ask a bot or use Take over, not to enter a URL above.
Settings › Apps & accounts no longer says "1 needs you" for a signed-out account that no bot uses.
The Inbox count turns amber only when a bot is waiting on you, and the sidebar highlights only the page you have open.
Draft goal cards on the Mission board show their whole title, and the "Waiting on you" tile no longer cuts its label.
A routine card says "Running" once while it runs, and Run now shows its icon on a phone.
New space no longer offers a "Copy bots · Coming soon" choice you can't pick.
Answering a card the instant it appears now reaches the bot instead of saying it expired.
A Telegram approval or question that closes while it's still being sent now says so, instead of keeping live buttons.
With many bots browsing at once, the browser closes the oldest idle bot page to make room, or says plainly that it's full.
